name: Hanking Gold International Limited
summary: Hanking Gold International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, smelting, and sale of mineral resources in the People's Republic of China, Australia, and Japan. It also operates Mt Bundy Gold Project in Northern Australia and Cygnet Gold Project located in Western Australia. In addition, the company engages in the sale of agricultural and forestry products; and manufacture and sale of green building materials. Further, it offers leasing services; travel and accommodation services; and technical development and technical consultation services.
